notes: This file describes what YOUR Google Flow account can do. Nothing here is checked automatically.
Flow models, modes, clip lengths and limits change, and they differ by plan and region. Open Flow, look at what you can actually select, and edit these values to match.
When a value is null it is unknown. Prompts treat it as 'do not rely on this'.
After checking in the Flow UI, set 'verified': true on the model and fill in verified_by_user_on (YYYY-MM-DD).

models.label: Omni Flash 1.2
models.notes: Unverified starter values. Confirm each mode actually appears for this model in your Flow UI, plus the clip length and ingredient limit. Disable any mode you cannot see.

generation_modes.text_to_video: Prompt only. Weakest identity control; use only for B-roll without the character.
generation_modes.frames_to_video: Start (and optionally end) image + prompt. Best for locking composition and continuity between clips.
generation_modes.ingredients_to_video: Reference images (character, product) + prompt. Main mode for keeping the character's identity.
generation_modes.video_to_video: Edit/extend an existing clip. Use only on clips you own (your own previous renders).
